changelog:
- Native Android Bottom Sheet Bridge: Tapping the three-dots menu on Android opens the complete native Android bottom sheet (Profile, Burn Session, Back/Forward/Refresh, Downloads, Saved Pages, History, AdShield Defense, Dual Screen Mode, Wallpapers & Themes, AI Page Summary, AI Trap Defuser, Diagnostics, and General Settings).
- Expanded Desktop Options: Desktop harness popover now includes Wallpapers & Themes, Burn Session, and Downloads in addition to Bookmarks, History, Shield, Settings, and New Tab.
- Verified Full Interactivity: Active tabs switcher modal and search engine switcher.
